title: Sand | Hyper-Realistic Sand Simulator in Your Browser
excerpt: Sand simulated with WebGL2 and JavaScript. Drag to draw, tilt your phone to slide the grains, and shake to scatter them. Play right in your browser.
content_html:
Hyper-realistic sand simulator

Built with WebGL2 and JavaScript. Push grains with your finger, tilt your phone to make them slide, or shake to scatter them. Play in your browser on phones, tablets and desktops.
